question: Israel x Iran ceasefire continues through August 31?
research:
I found no confirmed Israel-Iran strike on either country's territory from mid-July through August 15, 2026, and nothing that already settles this question. All page fetches failed (the proxy refused the connection), so everything below comes from search-result summaries, and I have not checked the primary pages myself. I have left out any result dated after 2026-08-15.

## 1. Resolution source
- The criteria give no URL. Archive copies of the market say it is decided by official information from the Israeli and Iranian governments and militaries, plus credible reporting. [polyguana](https://polyguana.com/market/3128787)
- I could not open the Polymarket page. A lines.com URL slug suggests the market was created around 2026-07-16, with about $1.1M in volume. Late-July snapshots show "Yes" around 85%; I could not confirm the date of a later 92.5% snapshot. [lines.com](https://www.lines.com/prediction-markets/politics/israel-x-iran-ceasefire-continues-throughptptpt-20260716224448963), [polyguana](https://polyguana.com/market/3128787)

## 2. Current status
- Shorter markets in the same series resolved "Yes". If the archives are right, the "through August 4" market resolved Yes on 2026-08-04 (about $1.4M traded) and the "August 9" market resolved Yes on 2026-08-13 (about $2.4M traded). That suggests no qualifying strike since market creation through at least August 9. The archives disagree on some titles and dates. [orrery](https://orrery.me/markets/israel-x-iran-ceasefire-continues-through-august-4), [polyguana](https://polyguana.com/resolved/3247931)
- For August 10 to 15, the only fighting I found was Israel striking Hezbollah in Lebanon, with nothing between Israel and Iran.

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-08-15: The Israeli military said it struck Hezbollah overnight near Nabatieh and Ansar in Lebanon; a strike on a home near Ansar reportedly killed seven. On 2026-08-14 a Tehran official said the Strait of Hormuz "will remain Iranian". [CBS](https://www.cbsnews.com/live-updates/iran-war-donald-trump-strait-of-hormuz-uae-accuses-attacks-vance-oil-gas/)
- 2026-08-04: Iran is building up its forces during the ceasefire and says it is ready to resume war if talks fail. Talks through Oman continue. [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/8/4/maximum-use-iran-boosts-military-strength-during-ceasefire-with-us)
- 2026-08-01/02: Trump called off planned strikes, saying the outline of a deal had been reached, including reopening Hormuz. He said Israel was on board, and negotiations were to start the following Monday. Iran said its talks are with Oman and are about safe shipping through Hormuz. [NBC](https://www.nbcnews.com/world/middle-east/state-department-urges-americans-consider-leaving-middle-east-region-rcna590396), [CBS](https://www.cbsnews.com/live-updates/iran-war-us-trump-strait-of-hormuz-kuwait-jordan-air-base/), [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/8/2/why-has-trump-halted-iran-attacks-and-what-is-the-deal-he-is-hinting-at), [CNN](https://www.cnn.com/2026/08/01/world/live-news/iran-war-trump)
- 2026-07-28: Israel's Defense Minister Katz said the US has been stopping Israel from hitting Iranian energy infrastructure. He said "We have struck Iran twice, and we are prepared to strike a third time." [CNN](https://www.cnn.com/2026/07/28/world/live-news/iran-trump-news)
- 2026-07-07 to 07-31: A US-only campaign of strikes on Iran followed Iranian attacks on ships in Hormuz. Iran fired back at US forces in Jordan, not at Israel. [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/July_2026_United_States_strikes_against_Iran), [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2026/7/18/iran-war-live-us-and-iran-exchange-attacks-for-7th-consecutive-night)
- 2026-07-09: Iran's state news agency IRNA said "US-Israeli" projectiles hit a site near Bushehr. Israeli officials said they were not aware of any Israeli involvement. [CNN](https://www.cnn.com/2026/07/09/world/live-news/iran-war-trump)

## 4. Base rates
- The war began 2026-02-28. The US-Iran ceasefire, which Israel joined, started 2026-04-08. [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/4/8/iran-war-what-is-happening-on-day-40-of-us-israeli-attacks/)
- Since April 8 I found one confirmed direct Israel-Iran exchange. On 2026-06-07/08 Iran fired missiles at Israel over an Israeli strike on Beirut, Israel hit military sites in Iran, and both stopped within about a day after Trump intervened. [Al Jazeera](https://aljazeera.com/news/2026/6/8/israel-and-iran-exchange-attacks-as-ceasefire-falters)
- So in roughly 4 months of ceasefire there was about one qualifying exchange, plus a disputed one on July 9. That is roughly one incident every 2 to 4 months. The question window is about 16 days (August 16 to 31).
- One pattern stands out: even when the US-Iran fighting resumed in July, the strikes stayed US-Iran and Israel and Iran did not hit each other. The June trigger was Lebanon.

## 5. Other forecasts
- 2026-08-11: The sister market "through September 30" was at 71%. [orrery](https://orrery.me/markets/israel-x-iran-ceasefire-continues-through-september-30)
- August 31 market: about 85% in late July. I could not confirm the current price as of August 15. [polyguana](https://polyguana.com/market/3128787)
- I found no Kalshi or Manifold markets and no expert forecasts.

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- About 2026-08-17: The 60-day window of the US-Iran memorandum signed around June 17-18 ends; reports differ on the exact signing date. Iran has said the 60-day clock is irrelevant because, in its view, the US broke the memorandum soon after signing. US threats at that point could restart strikes, but so far those have been US-only. I found no source dated on or before August 15 that confirms this deadline. [Congressional Research Service](https://www.congress.gov/crs-product/R48887)
- Oman-mediated talks over Hormuz, and whether Iran attacks shipping again, which set off the July fighting.
- Lebanon: continuing Israeli strikes on Hezbollah could set off Iranian retaliation, as happened in June.
- Pressure from Israeli leaders to strike Iranian energy sites, which Katz says the US has been blocking.
